analytical_question: What significance is defensible, and how should it influence this application decision?
general_et_finding: Abstain. No defined system, baseline or credible evidence supports any significance category.
application_finding: Unknown mechanism and benefit; no local significance can be established.
organization_specific_finding: Hypothetical midsize online retailer; Aggressive learning posture. Constraints and consequences are scenario assumptions, not measured outcomes.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Insufficient evidence to classify; no confidence in vendor claims.
value_opportunity_implication: Broader significance can justify learning and monitoring; test net local value separately.
risk_governance_implication: Human authority, appropriate data handling, measured quality and stop rules remain prerequisites; no legal or safety clearance is given.
recommendation_management_implication: Abstain from classification and adoption endorsement. Request a usable-system definition, baseline and independently checkable capability evidence.
change_monitoring_triggers: Replicated evidence of multi-tier barrier dissolution and durable dependencies.
Local comparative quality, net effort and incident evidence.
Changes in model, data access, autonomy or operating owner.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Define the system and comparator; supply original capability evidence.
